dataset_name: Blue Science Park member directory – audited NEXUS seed
scope_note: This audit verifies the listed profile facts against Blue Science Park individual member pages. It does NOT establish full directory completeness: the official directory has a dynamic 'Ladda mer' control, and Blue Science Park states it has over 80 members. The current audited package includes 55 organisations discovered from official profile pages / official related-member references. Run the crawler and reconcile every dynamic listing before claiming full coverage.
membership_note: Blue Science Park distinguishes membership and partnership in its application and fee description, but individual directory cards/profile pages do not consistently expose the exact membership class. Do not infer partner vs member. Use member_or_partner_not_individually_disclosed unless a source explicitly identifies the status.
